violation_type.title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Separate from Food and Inaccessible (26 TAC §747.3203(13))
violation_type.short_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Separate from Food and Inaccessible
violation_type.typical_finding: The kitchen cabinet beneath the sink was observed to have cleaning chemicals inside within children's reach. The bathroom was also observed to have multiple chemicals along the edge of the tub and along the kitchen sink.    ** The caregiver removed the chemicals and placed them in a cabinet out of children's reach.

finding_variants.text: The kitchen cabinet beneath the sink was observed to have cleaning chemicals inside within children's reach. The bathroom was also observed to have multiple chemicals along the edge of the tub and along the kitchen sink.    ** The caregiver removed the chemicals and placed them in a cabinet out of children's reach.
There was a bottle of cleaning solution in the bathroom where the children could access it. This was corrected during the inspection when the bottle was moved out of the reach of children.
There were lysol and cleaning products under the bathroom cabinet.
Cleaning supplies were noted to be accessible to the children on the top of the counter in the kitchen. This was corrected during the inspection when the products were removed.
During the inspection hygiene products  were  in the bathroom and accessible  to children.

Cleaning supplies were under the unlocked sink cabinets the cleaning supplies were accessible to the children.      NOTE: This was corrected at inspection when caregiver removed the cleaning supplies from under the sink and placing them on a shelf inaccessible to the children.
